en.headline: Crew member dies after being trapped in Tuen Mun ship crevice
en.dek: A man of about 62 was freed unconscious after nearly two hours in a cabin gap off Ho Yeung Street and was certified dead at Tuen Mun Hospital.
body: A crew member of about 62 died early on Thursday after falling into a narrow gap in a ship's cabin off Tuen Mun and remaining trapped for nearly two hours, according to local reports corroborated across several outlets.

Police received a report at about 1.07am to 1.18am that a man on a vessel preparing to berth off Ho Yeung Street, near the Tuen Mun river-trade terminal, had fallen from height into a crevice and could not be pulled out by colleagues. The vessel came alongside off No. 97 Ho Yeung Street while firefighters worked to free him.

Rescuers brought him out at about 3am. He was unconscious. Ambulance crews performed chest compressions at the scene and on the way to Tuen Mun Hospital, where he was certified dead at 3.37am, Hong Kong 01 reported, citing hospital observations that an automated CPR device was in use on arrival.
Police are treating the case as an industrial accident and investigating how the man fell. The man's identity has not been released.

zh.headline: 屯門船員墮船艙嬗隙被困近兩小時後不治
zh.dek: 約62歲男子清晨在浩洋街對開船上跌入船艙狹縫，消防近兩小時後救出時已昏迷，其後於屯門醫院證實死亡。
body: 屯門今晨發生工業意外，一名年約62歲船員從船上墮入船艙狹窄嬗隙，被困近兩小時後由消防救出，其後不治。
警方於凌晨約1時7分至1時18分接報，指一艘準備在浩洋街屯門內河船碼頭對開靠岸的船隻上，有人從高處墮下，夾在船艙嬗隙，同事無法自行救人。涉事船隻其後停泊在浩洋街97號對開海面等候救援。
消防約3時將事主救出，當時已陷入昏迷。救護員在現場及送院途中進行心肺復蘇，事主其後由屯門醫院於凌晨3時37分宣告不治。據了解，他送入急症室時須使用自動心肺復蘇機。
警方正以工業意外調查事發經過，死者身份未有公布。
